name: Compact RGB + utility science · 30/min · plate inputs

admission.note: The bulk-inserter unlock itself grants +1 capacity in installed 2.1.24; two items per hand, with no later capacity upgrades.

baseLabCapacity.assumption: One of each RGBY pack per research unit; no modules or research-speed bonuses

recommendations: Copper demand is 1795/min against 1800/min on a full two-lane red belt.
Provide at least 2154/min copper capacity (20% above demand); use 2 red belts or equivalent faster transport with balanced lanes.
Use the recommended machine counts for 20% nominal capacity above demand; check inserters and shared intermediate belts separately.

setupNotes: Red, green, blue and utility science from smelted plates, plastic, sulfur, sulfuric acid and lubricant. Every circuit, engine, battery, frame, processing unit and low-density structure is made inside. No modules or logistics delivery. Supply west entrances; collect four packs at the east providers. Keep isolated red stock-control networks. Supply both adjacent copper belts.
